title: Four in a row disc drop game
when: The user wants the vertical grid game where players drop discs into columns and try to line up four, against a friend or the computer.
prompt:
Goal: Correct gravity and win checks with a computer that plays real strategy.
Steps:
1. Board of 7 columns by 6 rows; logic.mjs drop(board, col, player) returns the row or -1 when full; winner(board, last) checks 4 directions from the last disc.
2. Computer: minimax with alpha beta to depth 5, center first ordering, scoring open windows of four; Easy wins or blocks, else random.
3. 7 column buttons above the grid with aria-label "Drop in column 3, 2 free"; arrows choose, Enter drops.
4. Disc falls with a translateY transition, instant under prefers-reduced-motion.
5. Status in aria-live; the winning four ringed and named.
6. Draw when full; scores in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: horizontal, vertical, both diagonals, full column, computer takes a win and blocks a loss.
Quality bar:
- Computer replies within 300 ms.
- Discs distinguishable by pattern too.
- Fits 360 px wide.
Pitfalls:
- Scanning the whole board for wins each move.
- Dropping into a full column.
- Clicks during the computer turn.
Verify:
- [ ] Wins tested in 4 directions.
- [ ] Column buttons labeled.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule present.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (board and search), test.mjs.

examples.input: jogo de quatro em linha contra o computador
examples.output: 7x6 grid, column buttons, Hard mode alpha beta, win ring
